summary: Verified TipJar Rate Wall — Portugal–Spanien leg is now correctly PENDING (amber badge, white match text, default border) and NOT rendered as LIVE/blue. Häcken–Djurgården leg stays WON (green). All 5 acceptance criteria pass on desktop 1920px and mobile 390px.
critical_code_review_comments: RateWall.jsx line 16-18: STATUS constant still declared but unused (filter uses inline array line 124) — dead code, safe to remove.

RateWall.jsx line 243: className concatenation `ls.cls.split(' ')[0].replace('/15','/30')` is a clever but fragile trick — if STATUS_META cls format changes (e.g., token order), border color silently falls back to elevated. Consider a dedicated `border` field in STATUS_META for clarity.
Silent poll in load() swallows all errors; ok for polling, but if the endpoint goes 500 the wall silently freezes on stale data. Consider logging via a dev flag.
